en.headline: Housing supervisor charged over HK$500,000 illegal online football bets
en.dek: Cheung Tsz-sum, 29, a Housing Department works supervisor, appeared in Tuen Mun Magistrates’ Courts and was granted bail pending a further hearing on 18 November.
body: A Housing Department works supervisor was charged on Wednesday with placing bets with an unlicensed bookmaker after the Independent Commission Against Corruption alleged he made more than 400 illegal online football bets totalling about HK$500,000 in one month.

Cheung Tsz-sum, 29, a grade one works supervisor, faces one count of betting with a bookmaker, contrary to section 8 of the Gambling Ordinance. The charge relates to bets on overseas football matches between early April and early May 2026. He was not required to enter a plea and the case was adjourned to 18 November. Bail was granted.

The ICAC said the case arose from a corruption complaint. It stressed that civil servants are held to high standards of integrity and that participating in illegal bookmaking breaches both the law and the expected conduct of the civil service. A related corruption investigation continues, and the Housing Department cooperated fully during the probe.

zh.headline: 房署監工涉非法外圍賭波約50萬元准保釋
zh.dek: 29歲一級監工張子森被控向收受賭注者投注，今日在屯門裁判法院提訊，押後至11月18日再訊，獲准保釋。
body: 廉政公署調查一宗貪污投訴後，揭發一名房屋署監工涉嫌於一個月內向非法網上賭博平台投注逾400次，涉及海外足球比賽，投注額約50萬元。
29歲被告張子森報稱房署一級監工，被控一項向收受賭注者投注罪，違反《賭博條例》第8條。控罪指他於2026年4月初至5月初期間投注足球比賽。他今日無需答辯，案件押後至11月18日再訊，期間獲准保釋。
廉署表示，公務員參與非法外圍賭博不但違法，更違背應有操守，會繼續為公務員團隊提供誠信教育。相關貪污調查仍在進行，房署在調查期間提供全面協助。
